title: 第2283章 困神阵第2282章 赤罡神刀
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
“咳咳咳！”
剧烈咳嗽声从神主口中传出，他挣扎着从地面起身，脸色难看到了极点。
不等神主喘口气，重新复活的灵玄机又冲了上来，对方在距离他不足十丈距离时直接炸开。
“轰隆！”
身受重伤的神主根本来不及躲避，再次被自爆能量波及，身躯又倒飞了出去。
“可恶，可恶！”
倒飞途中，神主怒吼连连，此时的他憋屈到了极点。
面对禁天二人这种战斗方式，他是真拿对方没什么办法。
想要破解这个局面，除非能抽空这方天地幽冥之气，可仅凭玄冥帆根本做不到。
神主深知，继续与神主二人战斗下去，自己只会越来越被动，这次的目标是禁忌生灵一族资源，没必要与他们多做纠缠。
想明白其中关键后，神主不再有任何迟疑，他直接转身就走，不给禁天二人靠近自己的机会。
凭借着极致身法，神主顷刻间便与禁天二人拉开距离。
“不好，那家伙想逃！”
察觉到神主打算逃跑，灵玄机连忙开口提醒禁天，做势便要追上去。
“等等！”
可灵玄机刚冲出去没多远，禁天却开口叫住了他。
灵玄机闻言连忙止住身形，他回头看向禁天，面带不解询问道：“禁主，这是我们斩杀他的最佳时机，为何不追？”
禁天看了神主消失方向一眼，淡淡回道：“若那家伙一心想跑，以他的速度，你认为我们追得上吗？”
“这……”
灵玄机语塞，一时间不知如何回应。

因为禁天说的确实是事实，神主身法十分玄妙，速度远在他们之上，想追上对方确实十分困难，大概率会无功而返。
可一想到就这么放对方离去，灵玄机又满是不甘。
毕竟对禁忌生灵一族来说，神主就如同悬在头顶的利剑，时刻威胁着他们。
若不将这个威胁处理掉，他们只能躲藏在混沌小世界内，实在太过憋屈。
看着灵玄灵那一脸憋屈的模样，禁天却是笑了，他自信开口：“放心，神主那家伙既然追过来，就不会轻易离去。”
“本帝若没猜错，神主之所以对唔族出手，大概率是为了资源，他想借助禁忌生灵一族囤积的资源冲击神帝境。”
“因此我们不用去追，只需去资源存放地蹲守即可，神主会自己自投罗网。”
听禁天如此一分析，灵玄机顿时眸光一亮，开口恭维道：“禁主英明。”
交谈结束后，禁天带着灵玄机直奔资源存放地而去。
禁天二人消失后不久，神主去而复返。
如今的神主面色略显苍白，刚才禁天与灵玄机的自爆攻击，给他造成了不小伤害。
好在玄冥帆不仅能抵挡幽冥之气侵蚀，更是能转换幽冥之气，便于神主吸收。
在玄冥帆的帮助下，神主借助转换后的幽冥之气，快速修复着自身伤势。
没一会功夫，神主伤势尽数恢复，原本破损的黑色铠甲，如今也再次复原。
伤势虽恢复了，但神主却发现，自身战力又下降了些许，此地对他的压制能力变得越来越强。
神主明白，留给自己的时间不多了。
content_en:
"Cough cough cough!"
A violent cough came from the Lord God's mouth. He struggled to get up from the ground, his expression extremely ugly.
Before the Divine Lord could take a breath, the resurrected Ling Xuanji rushed forward again, and the opponent exploded when it was less than ten feet away from him.
"Boom!"
The seriously injured God Lord had no time to dodge, and was once again affected by the self-destruction energy, and his body flew out again.
"Damn it, damn it!"
While flying upside down, the God Lord roared again and again. At this time, he was extremely aggrieved.
Faced with the fighting style of the two men, there was really nothing he could do to them.
If you want to break this situation, you must drain away the netherworld energy from this side of the world, but Xuan Ming Sail alone cannot do that.
The God Master knows very well that if he continues to fight against the two God Masters, he will only become more and more passive. The goal this time is to ban the resources of the living creatures, so there is no need to tangle with them.
After figuring out the key, the Divine Master no longer hesitated. He turned around and left without giving Jin Tian and his two men a chance to get close to him.
Relying on his ultimate physical skills, the God Lord instantly distanced himself from the two Jintians.
"No, that guy wants to escape!"
Realizing that the Lord of God was planning to escape, Ling Xuanji quickly spoke to remind Ji Tian and made a move to catch up.
"Wait!"
But not far after Ling Xuanji rushed out, Ji Tian called out to him.
Hearing this, Ling Xuanji quickly stopped. He turned back to look at Forbidden Heaven and asked with a puzzled expression: "Forbidden Lord, this is the best time for us to kill him. Why don't you chase him?"
Ji Tian glanced at the direction in which the God Lord disappeared, and replied calmly: "If that guy wants to run away, with his speed, do you think we can catch up?"
"This..."
Ling Xuanji was speechless and didn't know how to respond for a moment.
Because what Jin Tian said was indeed true. The God Lord's movements were very mysterious and his speed was far above them. It was indeed very difficult to catch up with the opponent, and there was a high probability that he would return in vain.
But when he thought of letting the other person go like this, Ling Xuanji felt unwilling to do so.
After all, to the forbidden creature clan, the God Lord is like a sharp sword hanging above their heads, threatening them at all times.
If this threat is not dealt with, they will have no choice but to hide in the small chaotic world, which is too frustrating.
Seeing the aggrieved look on Ling Xuanling's face, Ji Tian smiled, and he confidently said: "Don't worry, since the guy from the Lord is chasing me, he won't leave easily."
"If I guess correctly, the reason why the God Lord attacks the Hu clan is most likely for resources. He wants to use the resources hoarded by the forbidden creatures clan to attack the God Emperor realm."
"So we don't have to chase them. We just need to go to the resource storage area and stay there. The God Lord will fall into the trap himself."
Hearing Jin Tian's analysis, Ling Xuanji's eyes suddenly lit up and he complimented: "The Jin Lord is wise."
After the conversation, Ji Tian took Ling Xuanji and went straight to the resource storage place.
Shortly after Jin Tian and the others disappeared, the Lord of God left and returned.
The current God Lord looks a little pale. The self-destruction attacks of Jintian and Lingxuanji just now caused him a lot of damage.
Fortunately, the Xuan Ming Sail can not only resist the erosion of the Netherworld's energy, but can also convert the Netherworld's energy for easy absorption by the God Lord.
With the help of Xuan Mingfan, the God Master quickly repaired his own injuries with the help of the converted Nether Qi.
After a while, the God Lord recovered from all his injuries, and the originally damaged black armor was now restored again.
Although the injury recovered, the God Lord found that his combat power had dropped a little, and the suppression ability of this place became stronger and stronger.
The Lord of God understood that there was not much time left for him.
